note: One entry per model. A run names a model by its key; the key resolves to a
provider at run time, in this order:
1. endpoint - the model's own vendor endpoint, when its *_BASE_URL is set
2. azure    - the shared Azure deployment, when one exists for this model
3. openrouter - the aggregator, when OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set
A collaborator therefore only has to fill in their own two env vars; every
other model keeps working for everyone else through whatever they have.
endpoint.model: the id that vendor's own API expects. Verify it against the
provider's docs before a paid run -- several were placeholders.
price: USD per million tokens, the fallback when a provider reports no cost.
cache_read_multiplier: measured 2026-09-26, second-call cost over first-call
cost for a repeated prefix. 1.0 = the provider reported no cached tokens,
Gemini is Gemini 3.8 Flash, the model the team named; Google has shipped no
Gemini 4 (training confirmed July 2026, no model card, id or price).
